title: Q-GAP-multi-tenant-controls: Controls required before any multi-tenant hosted offering
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation tenantcontrols --ready
**Status:** closed

Multi-tenant hosting is a different obligation from a bring-your-own-account pilot. List and prove the controls in doctrine/pilot-model.json `multi_tenant_obligations` (isolation test, encryption, processor terms, breach path, per-tenant budget) in docs/security/multi-tenant-controls.json before the hosted tier is offered.

The list and its probes are doctrine/tenant-controls.json; docs/security/multi-tenant-controls.json is generated from them (2 of 5 proven on 2026-11-20). The done check passes only when every control is proven, not when the file exists.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 220.6 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
